reviewer: R06 manager source/context interface editorial review

scenes.location: Atraia flight, navigation, vehicle and combat controls
scenes.storyState: First flight to the military station, rescue and reunion before CS debrief.
scenes.purpose: Make the flight route, choices, repair/control settings, destruction feedback and star information understandable.
previousContext: Tomyu named Geist at the military station.
followingContext: Actual arrival on other worlds or a new CS assignment is beyond the section.
branchAlternatives: Both flight-menu variants, fighter launch/recall variants, auto/manual control, enabled/disabled repairs and failed navigation.
evidence: r06_ui.py guards original menu boxes, selector immediates, fixed overlay literals and protected runtime destination/star fields.
Independent R06 source inventory traces landing and space-map rendering.
uncertainty: Final pixels, movement and all settings combinations require runtime playtest.
notes: Atraia HUD replaces embedded Atlia variant consistently with established working English; source variation recorded in bible.
scenes.reviewNote: Read all Japanese menu actions and messages with their source handlers and parent menu context. Distinguish settings from immediate actions, launch preparation from launch completion, and navigation to a star from landing on a planet/station. Preserve dynamic name/count fields and all original action order.
